query:
SELECT s.id, s.name
                 FROM series s
                WHERE EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM series_works sw
                          JOIN manifestations m ON m.work_id = sw.work_id
                         WHERE sw.series_id = s.id
                      )
                  AND (s.name ILIKE $1 || '%' OR $2 <% s.name)
                ORDER BY (s.name ILIKE $1 || '%') DESC,
                         word_similarity($2, s.name) DESC,
                         s.name ASC
                LIMIT $3
